🌴 Puerto Rico Island RP 🌴
🔥 Realistic Roblox City Roleplay Experience 

Welcome to Puerto Rico Island RP, an immersive Roblox Roleplay (RP) game inspired by the culture and streets of Puerto Rico 🇵🇷. 

Create your story in an open world city RP where you can choose your path.

Caption: Become Police and protect the island 
Work as EMS,Cops or Civilian 
💰 Start jobs and businesses 
Join gangs and control territories 
🚗 Buy cars and explore the city 

Experience gang RP, police RP, crime RP, and city life in a realistic roleplay world. 

🛠 The game is currently under active development 
🔥 Regular updates and new systems. 

Keywords: Roblox RP, Puerto Rico RP, City RP, Gang RP, Police RP, Crime RP, Open World RP.
